clauses.scope_note: Section 14.12 makes Mistral AI solely responsible for providing support described in its Documentation or an Order Form; the actual support scope depends on those materials.
clauses.condition_explanation: The support obligation applies to the extent support is described in the Documentation or an Order Form. Those materials are not supplied here, so their specific support services cannot be determined.

obligation_items.content: Provide the support described in the Documentation or any Order Form.
obligation_items.trigger: When and to the extent support is described in the Documentation or an Order Form.

coverage_notes: The Documentation and any applicable Order Form are not supplied, so the specific support covered by the express obligation cannot be determined.

paragraph_audit.reason: Section 14.12 expressly makes Mistral AI responsible for providing described support; the clause models that obligation while preserving the limitation to support described in Documentation or an Order Form.
